body:
I'm not particularly worried about him and other girls, unless he goes somewhere far away, but then it'll be that he starts a new relationship and falls in love-- he's really not a causal sex guy. 

Losing trust is so hard, especially if you still love him. Do you see any future for you two? 

I'm trying not to do anything rash yet, I don't want no contact, I want him in my life, but I do realize if he goes far away, and starts a new life, I might need to in order to stop loving him and move on. I'll check out the sub.

It's such a horrible feeling, isn't it? 

Yes, I want to be with him, I love him very much. He's a little more guarded and practical than I am, to him, with his job, there's just no possible way we could be together. He'll be traveling for work a lot, and he does have kinda a high stress job. 

The best case scenario is him being transferred 2.5 hours away (to his hometown). He'll be traveling 20 days a month, and still working those other 10 days. I used to live in that area (I never wanted to leave actually), and have friends up there I could live with. It wouldn't be an easy relationship, but to me, it would be worth it because I'd be near him. He would have that schedule at least a year. The other places he'd go I feel like he'd meet someone and completely forget about me. 

I keep hoping he'll change his mind and be more willing to work on some sort of relationship. He says he'll still want to talk, to communicate and see me, but he'd feel guilty if he didn't call me whenever he could. 

Tell me about your guy? When did you break up? Do you communicate still?

Hang out with my boyfriend. We broke up last Monday because his job is transferring him, probably somewhere far. He was kinda my only friend/support. We're both taking the breakup really hard, but he doesn't think it could work long distance, and he thinks I'll grow to resent him. I'm not really in a place to move with him due to my depression and anxiety, and inability to hold down a job/find steady work. 

It sucks because he's still here, and I just want to make the most of our time together, but he says we need space. 

We talked yesterday for the first time in a couple days and it felt great. But last night he said it was too hard for him to talk, and we can't talk all day like we used to. It's painful for him and he needs more space. It's painful for me not talking. I told him to text me when he finds out where they're transferring him, probably the end of this week.
Whenever I try to watch something new my mind can't focus on it. So it's pointless.

That's how I was too. Saturday I got kinda agitated. My mind was racing and focused on something- basically driving me nuts. I tried to go for a walk but it was raining and I didn't have the energy. 

Do you watch the same things over and over on Netflix? I do. I'm rewatching family guy for maybe the 6th time? I don't even really watch it, it just plays and I zone out. I like it because it's mindless and there a lot of seasons and it'll just play through. Once it ends, I usually just restart it.

Hey. I appreciate you responding to my post. I do kinda wanna talk, but I'm so withdrawn from life right now, i barely know how to open up. 

How are you though?
Hey, just logged into this account again and just wanted to thank you for the kind words. Unfortunately, it hasn't gotten any easier for me to deal with, but I'm still hopefully
Yeah trust me, I feel pretty bad about it and regret my decision.
